svg.title: End of life: a patient who cannot decide gets a substitute decision maker in a fixed order; palliative care is reached by four routes and aims at comfort; a patient who asks for medical assistance in dying must meet every eligibility criterion, and the stream (natural death foreseeable or not) sets the safeguards; a last IN PRACTICE row gives palliative pearls under palliative care, and how MAiD is delivered plus conscientious objection across both streams
